jobs.title: Sales Advisor  | Contratto a Chiamata | Forlì
jobs.description: COSA FARAI Come Sales Advisor in H&M, avrai un ruolo fondamentale nel creare un’eccezionale esperienza al cliente. Accoglierai i clienti, li guiderai all’interno del negozio e li supporterai nella scelta, valorizzando i nostri prodotti. Agendo in linea con i nostri valori, contribuirai al tuo successo e a quello dell’azienda.  Ti occuperai di:  Condividere la tua conoscenza della moda e dei prodotti per aiutare i clienti a fare scelte accurate.  Collaborare con il tuo team per offrire un servizio eccezionale in ogni fase del percorso del cliente.  Garantire che l’area vendita e il magazzino siano sempre ben forniti, ordinati e accoglienti.  Supportare le attività di apertura e chiusura del negozio. Rappresentare te stesso e il brand in modo positivo durante tutte le interazioni con i clienti.  CON CHI LAVORERAI  I nostri negozi sono il cuore pulsante della nostra azienda, dove i clienti vivono in prima persona l’esperienza del brand. Come parte del dinamico Team del negozio, ogni ruolo - Sales Advisor, Department Manager, Store Manager e Visual Merchandiser - contribuisce a creare un ambiente ispirante e accogliente. Avrai anche l’opportunità di collaborare con il Team di Area, condividendo idee e strategie per raggiungere insieme il successo.  Con il tuo team, giocherai un ruolo fondamentale nell’aiutare i clienti a sentirsi sicuri di sé ed esprimere la propria individualità, grazie alle ultime tendenze e agli stili intramontabili.  Creando connessioni autentiche con i clienti nei nostri negozi, rendiamo la moda accessibile   per tutti.    ​ CHI SEI  Cerchiamo persone con:  Esperienza nel servizio al cliente, preferibilmente nel settore moda, retail o ambiti affini.  E persone che siano:  Appassionate di fashion e orientate a offrire un’eccezionale esperienza in-store, promuovendo i nostri prodotti e contribuendo a raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita.  Proattive e capaci di lavorare in ambienti collaborativi e dinamici.  Comunicative, creative, curiose nell’utilizzo della tecnologia in negozio, con una forte motivazione ad apprendere e svilupparsi.   Flessibili e orientate all’azione.  CHI SIAMO   H&M Group è un’azienda globale che riunisce diversi brand di moda e business ventures. Il nostro obiettivo è dimostrare che non esiste compromesso tra design eccezionale, prezzi accessibili e soluzioni sostenibili. Vogliamo rendere la moda libera e accessibile a tutti, mettendo i nostri clienti al centro di ogni decisione. Siamo migliaia di colleghi appassionati e di talento, uniti dalla nostra cultura e da valori condivisi. Insieme, vogliamo usare la nostra forza, la nostra conoscenza e le nostre competenze per guidare l’industria della moda verso un futuro più inclusivo e sostenibile.  ​PERCHÉ TI PIACERÀ LAVORARE CON NOI  In H&M Group siamo orgogliosi di essere un’azienda dinamica e inclusiva. L’esperienza che i nostri colleghi contribuiscono a creare ogni giorno è stata anche riconosciuta attraverso premi come: Europe’s Best Employers 2026 – Financial Times Top 10 Diversity Brand Index Italia. Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti benefit vantaggiosi e numerose opportunità di sviluppo a livello globale.  Sconto del 25% per i dipendenti su tutti i brand di H&M Group, sia nei negozi fisici che online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories e ARKET).  Programma di Incentivi H&M (HIP) – un piano di incentivi globale che premia la dedizione a lungo termine.  Buoni pasto di 6 euro per ogni giornata lavorativa di almeno 6 ore.  Accesso al portale aziendale dedicato ai benefit, con oltre 1500 sconti su prodotti e servizi per il benessere e la vita quotidiana.  Formazione iniziale dedicata, per accompagnarti al meglio nel tuo percorso in azienda.  Crescita e sviluppo - In H&M investiamo nello sviluppo dei talenti attraverso formazione continua e percorsi strutturati come training, e-learning, Talent Day, Skill Seminar e dialoghi individuali. Crediamo nella crescita professionale come parte integrante dell’esperienza lavorativa. UNISCITI A NOI La nostra unicità nasce dalla combinazione di molti elementi: una cultura inclusiva e collaborativa, valori forti e reali opportunità di crescita. Sono soprattutto le persone a renderci ciò che siamo. Fai il prossimo passo nella tua carriera insieme a noi. Il tuo percorso inizia qui. ALTRE INFORMAZIONI Retribuzione contratto Job on Call: Per questo ruolo offriamo una retribuzione oraria fissa di € 9,87 lordi all’ora, corrispondente al Livello di inquadramento 5° (CCNL di riferimento: Commercio) + terzo elemento provinciale, variabile in funzione della provincia sede di lavoro.  * Valutazione per Ruoli in store: p er gestire l'alto volume di candidature per il ruolo di Sales Advisor, utilizziamo un metodo di valutazione online per il reclutamento basato sulle competenze nei nostri negozi. Dovrai completarlo come parte del processo di candidatura e selezione. Le tue risposte saranno valutate da uno strumento di valutazione che applica criteri predefiniti stabiliti da H&M Group. Dopo aver completato la valutazione, avrai l'opportunità di condividere feedback e fare domande. Se riscontri difficoltà o preferisci un metodo di valutazione alternativo, contatta  recruitment_support@hm.com . Scegliere un'alternativa non influirà sulla tua candidatura. Per ulteriori informazioni su come trattiamo i tuoi dati personali, consulta la nostra Informativa sulla Privacy. ** Ci impegniamo in un processo di recruitment che sia equo, imparziale e basato sulle competenze.

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Digital Product
jobs.description: As Business Analyst, you will be part of the COS Product Team. You will collaborate with the Product Manager and Business Experts to craft seamless experiences by understanding business objectives and technological capabilities to ensure we solve real customer problems. You will be  responsible for facilitating the development process by gathering information, supporting to prioritise backlogs and drive feature development. You will take ownership for managing Jira backlog health and Jira tickets to ensure speed, a smooth collaboration and alignment on new initiatives. What you will do:  Secure Jira governance and improvements to guidelines, ensure stakeholders are onboarded  and delivering to expectations. Improve health of the backlog, increasing the % of well-defined user stories ready for development.  Facilitate agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement sessions, and ensure that development tasks are well-defined and actionable. Support the Product Manager with organising and leading stakeholder meetings and non-technical workshops to encourage cross-functional engagement and feedback. Coordinate with operational and development teams to resolve incidents and maintain system performance. Host knowledge transfer sessions or onboarding support for new team members or external consultants.​ Engage with UX/UI design teams to ensure business requirements are reflected in user experiences Work with Data Analysts/Engineers to ensure data definitions and metrics are consistent and trustworthy​ Lead the creation and delivery of feature requests, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical feasibility Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and demos to align with delivery progress and team goals. Maintain confluence pages, or dashboards to track requirement status, business rules, and changes.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description: The Social Media Specialist will support the growth and evolution of our social channels, combining creativity, cultural awareness and data-led thinking to deliver engaging, relevant and high-performing social content. Working across organic and paid social, the role will turn audience, platform and performance insights into actionable recommendations, helping to strengthen our social presence, grow our community and support wider brand and commercial objectives. What you will do:  Grow and evolve our social channels:  Drive continuous content, community and performance analysis to identify opportunities for channel growth. Develop recommendations in partnership with the Social Media Manager and Head of Content and use performance insights to continually evolve social-first content.​ Drive social performance and optimisation:  Continuously evaluate social performance, translating data into actionable insights and regular reporting. Maximise the impact of paid social by using social insights, trends, content learnings and creator opportunities to inform and optimise paid strategy, with a particular focus on TikTok.​ Build brand relevance through social:  Stay ahead of the evolving social landscape, identifying emerging trends, platform behaviours, creators and formats across Instagram, TikTok as well as wider and emerging social platforms. Translate these into relevant opportunities for COS and ensure the brand remains culturally relevant and progressive.​ Shape social-first creative:  Partner closely with the Social Media team, Art Directors and Copy team to inform and develop creative for shoots and social channels. Use audience insights, trend analysis, platform expertise and performance data to help shape creative direction, maximise relevance and evolve the social tone of voice.​ Develop social partnerships and opportunities:  Partner with the Paid Media team on paid social activity, with a particular focus on TikTok, sharing insights, trends, content learnings and creator opportunities. Identify opportunities across creators, cultural moments, emerging formats and social commerce to support channel and commercial growth.​ Collaborate across the business:  Coordinate cross-functional workflows from content ideation through to execution, managing briefs, timelines and delivery. Contribute social expertise and insights to wider brand activity and maintain strong relationships with external platform representatives to identify opportunities to develop our channels.​

jobs.title: Sales Advisor 8h, 12h and 20h
jobs.description: As the Sales Advisor, you are the friendly face that greet our customers and embody the heart of our brand.  You'll have the opportunity to provide customers with high-level service at every turn. From initiating conversations to assisting at the cash desk, fitting rooms and throughout the shop floor, you'll play a vital role in enhancing the shopping experience. Your responsibilities will also include processing deliveries, replenishing stock and merchandising the latest garments on the shop floor.  Your role is essential in creating welcoming experiences that showcase the best of our brand. With warmth and enthusiasm, you'll guide our customers through their journey, offering genuine assistance and proactive service to uplift and inspire. Together, in collaboration with your team, you’ll create moments that matter.  While previous experience in customer service and familiarity with fabrics are nice to have, they're not mandatory.

jobs.title: Sales Advisor (20 ore)
jobs.description: Come Sales Advisor, sei il volto amichevole che accoglie i nostri clienti e incarna il cuore del nostro brand.  Avrai l’opportunità di offrire ai clienti un servizio di alto livello in ogni momento. Dall’iniziare conversazioni all’assistenza alla cassa, nei camerini e sullo shop floor, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel migliorare l’esperienza di acquisto. Le tue responsabilità includeranno anche la gestione delle consegne, il rifornimento dello stock e il merchandising dei capi più recenti sullo shop floor.  Il tuo ruolo è essenziale per creare esperienze accoglienti che mostrino il meglio del nostro brand. Con calore ed entusiasmo, guiderai i clienti nel loro percorso, offrendo assistenza autentica e un servizio proattivo per ispirare e valorizzare. In collaborazione con il tuo team, creerai momenti che contano.  Sebbene l’esperienza precedente nel servizio clienti e la familiarità con i tessuti siano un plus, non sono requisiti obbligatori.

jobs.title: Assistant Buyer - Menswear
jobs.description: As an Assistant Buyer on the menswear team, you will support product development across all knitwear categories. You will contribute to driving sales and profitability by supporting the development of a strong, customer‑focused assortment aligned with COS aesthetics. Working closely with Buying, Design, Pattern, Production, Material, and Supply Chain teams, you will help secure orders that meet brand and customer requirements across time, price, quality, and quantity, supporting meaningful growth within the department. What you will do: Be part of reviewing and analysing the departments product, assortment, quantity and selling, considering actions according to the business needs and present sales figures. Support to maximize the departments sales and profitability by maintaining timelines both before and after order replacement. Monitor and react to how the departments customers are affected by trends and their surroundings Drive the day-to-day organization within your team Manage the post flow to and from recipients Conduct regular analysis of our competitors and provide insights to your team, ensuring we offer our customers great value for money. Communicate with the production office regarding product development. Follow up order placements and meet deadlines. Support with driving the product development from start to end and in close collaboration with the buyer and in line with dept margin targets. Prepare and assist fittings, organize agenda, provide samples at the right place, right time and right quantity. Responsible for handling samples as well as overseeing and maintain the sample wardrobe, making sure all samples are kept neat and tidy Raise orders and order updates.

jobs.title: SALES ADVISOR - OXFORD STREET EAST (PART-TIME)
jobs.description: These are temporary part-time 8, 16 & 20 hour positions based in the H&M Oxford Street East store in Central London. For this position we will require 2-5 days flexibility, including the weekends.   WHAT YOU’LL DO ​ As a H&M Sales Advisor, you will be essential in delivering an exceptional shopping experience. Some of your responsibilities will include: ​Representing the H&M Brand positively and engaging with our customers to provide an excellent service and an exciting shopping experience. Supporting with commercial and operational actions together with your colleagues, to reach store goals and sales targets. Keep informed about the latest fashion trends, brands and competitors, using your knowledge to inspire and guide our customers. Providing and receiving feedback to support yourself and your colleagues to learn and develop.   WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH ​ Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers will experience our brand firsthand. Being part of a dynamic Store Team, which include, Sales Advisors, Team Leaders, Department Managers, Visual Merchandisers and Store Managers, together you will create an inspirational environment for our customer and colleagues.   WHO YOU ARE ​ We welcome applicants who are: Passionate about people and fashion. Self-motivated and able to motivate others to ensure strong teamwork. Clear communicators, creative and curious. Motivated to contribute to H&M's vision, leading us to success.   WHO WE ARE ​ H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​ ​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​   WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  ​ At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​[Please see below some of the benefits available to our Sales Advisors] Global Employee Discount of 25% across the H&M Group [H&M, COS, & Other Stories, Monki, Weekday, Arket and H&M Home] Health and Lifestyle Benefits The Retail Trust – Employee Assistance Programme Benefit Hub, offering exclusive discounts Company Sick Pay Workplace Pension Scheme   JOIN US ​ Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​ Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​   ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Unfortunately, this is not a position that we are able to offer sponsorship for under the skilled worker route. Should you decide to apply for one of our Sales Advisor positions, you will be asked to complete an online interactive assessment as part of your application. Here you will answer a series of questions, all based on the role and the responsibilities of a Sales Advisor in H&M. Please do keep an eye out for this email and link, as it may end up in your junk mail. *For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice. ** W e are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter to your application.

jobs.title: Visual Merchandiser Manager, Regent St
jobs.description: As a Visual Merchandiser Manager, you play a pivotal role in shaping an exceptional in-store customer journey. With a keen eye for aesthetics and a strong commercial mindset, you bring the brand's vision to life, elevating the collection in a way that is both inspiring and aligned with business goals. Supporting the Area Visual Manager, you drive consistent and elevated visual merchandising execution across your responsible stores, ensuring brand standards are delivered while adapting to local market needs. Your work enhances the visual appeal of the store, strengthens customer engagement, and contributes to sales performance through commercially impactful visual presentations. Key Responsibilities:  Deliver an exceptional customer experience through inspiring visual merchandising, styling expertise, and strong product knowledge. Execute Global Visual Brand Guidelines across windows, mannequins, and in-store displays to ensure a consistent and commercial customer experience. Interpret sales performance, customer insights, and local market trends to drive visual merchandising decisions and commercial results. Adapt regional visual direction to local market needs while maintaining brand consistency and integrity. Plan and implement impactful window displays, mannequin styling, and shop floor presentations that inspire customers and support business goals. Conduct regular store visits, monitor visual standards, and provide coaching and feedback to enhance execution across responsible stores. Lead, develop, and inspire a team of Visual Merchandiser(s), ensuring high standards and consistent delivery. Collaborate with the Area Visual Manager and Store Management teams to implement visual updates, share best practices, and drive continuous improvement. Monitor and report on visual merchandising performance, identifying opportunities to improve standards and results. Act as a brand ambassador and visual merchandising expert, ensuring every visual touchpoint enhances the customer journey.

jobs.title: Department (Concession) Manager
jobs.description: As a Department Manager  you’re be at the forefront of creating excellent customer experiences that go beyond the expected.  With a passionate and dedicated team by your side, you will lead with energy and purpose—setting the tone for a store environment that’s not only welcoming and inspiring but also drives results. Your leadership ensures every customer journey feels personal, genuine, and memorable, while your focus on service and operational excellence helps bring the brand to life on the shop floor.  Key Responsibilities  Deliver a high level of customer service through expert styling advice, strong product knowledge, and an engaging store experience  Analyse sales data and collaborate with the Store/Concession Manager to maximise department performance  Lead and motivate a team of Sales Advisors to consistently achieve service and presentation standards  Support recruitment efforts and ensure effective onboarding and training for new team members  Identify and nurture future talent, contributing to development plans that support team progression  Oversee daily store operations, ensuring efficiency and alignment with brand standards  Act as a brand ambassador, consistently delivering the best possible experience for every customer  Step into the role of Store  Manager when required, ensuring continuity in leadership and performance

jobs.title: Department Manager | Parma
jobs.description: COSA FARAI In qualità di Department Manager, sarai una figura chiave nel supportare, incoraggiare e ispirare il team, favorendo collaborazione, coinvolgimento e il raggiungimento degli obiettivi comuni. Promuoverai una cultura inclusiva che valorizza la collaborazione e stimola lo spirito imprenditoriale, creando un ambiente in cui ogni persona possa crescere e svilupparsi. Le tue responsabilità includeranno: Guidare il team nel garantire un’esperienza cliente eccellente, assicurando elevati standard operativi e di visual merchandising, e promuovendo attivamente la vendita dei prodotti. Essere responsabile delle performance del proprio reparto: analizzare i risultati di vendita, identificare opportunità commerciali e definire obiettivi chiari, sviluppando piani d’azione per ottimizzare vendite, profittabilità e gestione dello stock Gestire efficacemente la pianificazione del team, assicurando il corretto svolgimento delle routine di apertura e chiusura del punto vendita. Selezionare, inserire e sviluppare i talenti del team, promuovendo una cultura inclusiva, collaborativa e orientata alla crescita continua e all’innovazione. Mantenersi costantemente aggiornato sulle tendenze moda, sulle preferenze dei clienti e sulle attività dei competitor, per garantire un’offerta sempre rilevante. Rappresentare il brand in modo positivo e coerente in ogni interazione con i clienti, incarnandone i valori e lo stile.    CON CHI LAVORERAI I nostri negozi sono il cuore della nostra azienda, il luogo in cui i clienti vivono in prima persona il nostro brand. Come parte del dinamico team di negozio, ogni ruolo contribuisce a creare un ambiente stimolante e accogliente. Forti capacità di leadership, con una passione per il coaching e lo sviluppo dei team, esemplificando al contempo i valori e la cultura aziendale. Competenze nella pianificazione, analisi e follow-up delle vendite, utilizzando strumenti e reports incentrati sul cliente. E persone che... ​ Dimostrano una leadership solida e consapevole, ispirando, supportando e sviluppando il team con integrità. L’obiettivo è dimostrare che non esiste compromesso tra design eccellente, prezzi accessibili e soluzioni sostenibili. La volontà è rendere la moda libera e accessibile a tutte le persone, mettendo i clienti al centro di ogni decisione. Il gruppo è composto da migliaia di persone appassionate e di talento, unite da una cultura e da valori condivisi. Insieme, vogliamo valorizzare la nostra forza, la nostra dimensione globale e le nostre competenze per guidare l’industria della moda verso un futuro più inclusivo e sostenibile.   PERCHÉ TI PIACERÀ LAVORARE CON NOI? In H&M Group siamo orgogliosi di essere un’azienda dinamica e inclusiva. L’esperienza che i nostri colleghi contribuiscono a creare ogni giorno è stata anche riconosciuta attraverso premi come: Europe’s Best Employers 2026 – Financial Times Top 10 Diversity Brand Index Italia. Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti benefit vantaggiosi e numerose opportunità di sviluppo a livello globale.  Sconto del 25% per il personale  su tutti i brand del Gruppo H&M, sia nei negozi fisici che online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories e ARKET). Programma di Incentivi H&M (HIP)  – un piano di incentivi globale che premia la dedizione a lungo termine. Buoni pasto di 6 euro  per ogni giornata lavorativa di almeno 6 ore. Accesso al portale di benefit aziendale , con oltre 1500 sconti su prodotti e servizi per il benessere e la vita quotidiana. Fondo Est -  fondo di assistenza sanitaria integrativa  prevista per i lavoratori dipendenti dei CCNL Terziario: istituito in favore di tutti i dipendenti a tempo indeterminato. Formazione iniziale  dedicata, per accompagnarti al meglio nel tuo percorso in azienda. Crescita e sviluppo -  In H&M investiamo nello sviluppo dei talenti attraverso formazione continua e percorsi strutturati come training, e-learning, Talent Day, Skill Seminar e dialoghi individuali. Crediamo nella crescita professionale come parte integrante dell’esperienza lavorativa.  UNISCITI A NOI La nostra unicità nasce da una combinazione di elementi: una cultura inclusiva e collaborativa, valori solidi e un forte impegno nello sviluppo e nella crescita. Ma soprattutto, sono le persone a fare la differenza e a renderci ciò che siamo. Fai il passo successivo nella tua carriera insieme a noi. Il viaggio inizia qui.​

jobs.title: Floor Manager, Spitalfields
jobs.description: As a Floor Manager, you will be at the forefront of creating excellent customer experiences that go beyond the expected. With a passionate and dedicated team by your side, you will lead with energy and purpose—setting the tone for a store environment that’s not only welcoming and inspiring but also drives results. Your leadership ensures every customer journey feels personal, genuine, and memorable, while your focus on service and operational excellence helps bring the brand to life on the shop floor. Key Responsibilities Deliver a high level of customer service through expert styling advice, strong product knowledge, and an engaging store experience Analyse sales data and collaborate with the Store Manager to maximise department performance Lead and motivate a team of Sales Advisors to consistently achieve service and presentation standards Support recruitment efforts and ensure effective onboarding and training for new team members Identify and nurture future talent, contributing to development plans that support team progression Oversee daily store operations, ensuring efficiency and alignment with brand standards Act as a brand ambassador, consistently delivering the best possible experience for every customer Step into the role of Store when required, ensuring continuity in leadership and performance

jobs.title: Area Manager | Roma
jobs.description: WHAT YOU'LL DO As an Area Manager, you lead and develop a group of stores together with Store Managers to drive business performance, operational excellence, and an outstanding customer experience. Through coaching, collaboration, and strategic follow-up, you ensure consistent execution across your area while contributing to sustainable growth and strong people engagement.  You will:  Lead, coach, and develop Store Managers and store teams to deliver strong commercial and operational results.  Drive sales and profitability through KPI analysis, business follow-up, and execution of commercial priorities.  Ensure stores operate according to H&M standards, policies, routines, and legal requirements.  Recruit, develop, and secure succession for future store leaders across the area.  Collaborate with key functions to translate business strategies into strong local execution.  Lead change initiatives, including store openings, operational rollouts, and new concepts.  Ensure excellent customer experiences through consistent store standards and coaching.  Oversee store maintenance, health & safety, sustainability, and operational efficiency.  Identify business opportunities, risks, and local market trends to support growth.  Act as the key escalation point for operational challenges and performance follow-up.  Who You'll Work With  You will work closely with Store Managers and store teams while partnering with colleagues across Commercial, Visual, Expansion, People, Tech, and Operations functions to drive business performance and aligned execution across your stores.    ​ WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You will work closely with Store Managers, store teams, and Sales Market partners across Commercial, Visual, Expansion, People, and Operations functions to secure aligned execution and business performance across your assigned stores.    WHO YOU ARE  We are looking for people with:  2+ years of experience in multi-store retail management.  Experience leading and developing leaders and high-performing teams.  Strong commercial acumen and experience driving sales and KPI performance.  Experience analyzing business results and translating insights into actions.  Experience managing retail operations, compliance, and store standards.  Experience recruiting, developing, and building succession plans.  Experience leading operational rollouts, change, or business improvement initiatives.  Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Fluency in English.  And people who are:  Customer-focused and results-driven.  Strong communicators who build trust and collaboration.  Confident decision-makers who use data and insights effectively.  Adaptable and comfortable in a fast-paced retail environment.  Inclusive leaders who foster engagement, accountability, and high performance.    WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​ We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​    WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE  At H&M Group, we are proud to be a dynamic and inclusive company. The experience our colleagues help create every day has also been recognized through awards such as:  Europe’s Best Employers 2026 – Financial Times  Top 10 Diversity Brand Index Italy  We offer attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities worldwide:  25% staff discount across all H&M Group brands, both in-store and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, and ARKET).  H&M Incentive Program (HIP), a global program that rewards long-term commitment and dedication.  Meal vouchers worth €6 for each working day of at least six hours.  Access to our corporate benefits platform, featuring more than 1,500 discounts on products and services that support everyday life and wellbeing.  Comprehensive onboarding and training, designed to help you get the best possible start in your new role.  Growth and development opportunities through continuous learning and structured development initiatives, including training programs, e-learning, Talent Days, Skill Seminars, and individual development dialogues. We believe professional growth is an integral part of employee experience.    JOIN US​  Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​    ​ADDITIONAL INFORMATION   This is a full-time, permanent role. The gross annual salary (RAL) for this position starts from €46’000,00. The final offer will be determined based on professional experience, skills, and specific qualifications.  This role requires flexibility and availability to support business needs across the entire national territory.   ​*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter to your application.​  ** To help us manage the high volume of applications for this role, we use a skills-based assessment as part of our recruitment process. As part of your application, you will be asked to complete an assessment designed to evaluate skills relevant to the position. Your responses will be evaluated using predefined criteria established by H&M Group, ensuring a fair and consistent assessment process for all candidates. After completing the assessment, you will have the opportunity to provide feedback and ask any questions you may have.  For more information about how we process your personal data, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Sales Advisor 30h (Temporary)
jobs.description: As the Sales Advisor, you are the friendly face that greet our customers and embody the heart of our brand.  You'll have the opportunity to provide customers with high-level service at every turn. jobs.title: Senior Freelance Womenswear Designer
jobs.description: At COS, we believe in the power of creative collaboration and the art of timeless design. We are always eager to connect with freelance fashion designers who share our passion for modernity, functional elegance, and innovative craftsmanship. If you are driven to create garments that inspire—pieces that blend sophistication with practicality and elevate everyday wear—we would love to hear your story. We warmly welcome speculative applications from designers who want to shape the future of fashion alongside us. As a freelance partner, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to concept development, push boundaries through design exploration, refine products, and infuse our collections with your unique vision. Although we are keen to connect with talented designers at all stages of their careers, we are especially interested in meeting accomplished senior creatives with expertise and experience in the womenswear collection, other candidates are welcome to register their interest for other freelance positions that may arise in the future.  What We’re Looking For We’re particularly interested in hearing from designers who can demonstrate: A strong aesthetic aligned with the COS design philosophy – Modern, brand relevant, effortless design – Silhouette driven designs and innovative construction – A depth or understanding for fabric, technique, and thoughtful detail Proven design experience within womenswear, menswear, or accessories – Experience in contemporary, premium, or luxury fashion markets – Strong ability to interpret brand DNA into commercially relevant design Excellent portfolio that showcases: – Concept development – Research and mood exploration – Technical sketches and garment details – Final product or collection outcomes – Exploration of materials, textures, and sustainable design approach  Strong technical and creative capabilities – Confident hand and digital sketching – Understanding of pattern cutting and garment construction – Ability to work with 3D design tools Collaborative approach & professional communication – Ability to work to briefs, timelines, and feedback – Experience working with product development teams or manufacturers – Strong organisation and self-management How to Apply If you’re interested in being considered for upcoming freelance opportunities, please upload Your CV Portfolio or PDF of recent work (or link to online portfolio) A short introduction outlining your design focus and availability Please note that all freelance roles require spending a significant amount of time working from our beautiful, art-deco inspired office and atelier in central London. Regular commuting to London is therefore essential for anyone considering a freelance position with us.

jobs.description: As an Assistant Buyer on the menswear team, you will support product development across all knitwear categories. You will contribute to driving sales and profitability by supporting the development of a strong, customer‑focused assortment aligned with COS aesthetics. Working closely with Buying, Design, Pattern, Production, Material, and Supply Chain teams, you will help secure orders that meet brand and customer requirements across time, price, quality, and quantity, supporting meaningful growth within the department. What you will do: Be part of reviewing and analysing the departments product, assortment, quantity and selling, considering actions according to the business needs and present sales figures. Support to maximize the departments sales and profitability by maintaining timelines both before and after order replacement. Monitor and react to how the departments customers are affected by trends and their surroundings Drive the day-to-day organization within your team Manage the post flow to and from recipients Conduct regular analysis of our competitors and provide insights to your team, ensuring we offer our customers great value for money. Communicate with the production office regarding product development. Follow up order placements and meet deadlines. Support with driving the product development from start to end and in close collaboration with the buyer and in line with dept margin targets. Prepare and assist fittings, organize agenda, provide samples at the right place, right time and right quantity. Responsible for handling samples as well as overseeing and maintain the sample wardrobe, making sure all samples are kept neat and tidy Raise orders and order updates.
